info.name: Smart HR System API
info.description: Full collection of Smart HR System backend endpoints. Import the accompanying environment file and run 'Login' first to auto-fill the {{token}} variable.

request.description: A plain 'employee' role can only fetch their own record here — cross-employee lookups return 403 unless the caller is manager/hr_admin.
Composes attendance, leave requests, payroll and evaluations for this employee into a single response. Same ownership rule as 'Get Employee' — a plain employee can only view their own.

request.description: If the AI/rule-based logic can't answer confidently, the response has escalated:true, the employee is notified, and every hr_admin is notified + the question is added to the 'List Escalated Questions' queue below.
hr_admin only. The queue of employee questions the AI HR Companion could not answer confidently, for HR to follow up on.
Any employee can upload their own document — no HR role required. 'type' must be one of the Document model's enum values (e.g. contract, certificate, id, other).
HR/manager uploading a document on behalf of a specific employee.
Streams the file as a binary download. Accessible to the owning employee, their manager, or HR — uploaded files are never publicly reachable (no /uploads static route).
manager/hr_admin only. All pending requests across every employee in one list — a manager only sees their own department's team, hr_admin sees everyone.
The 'attachment' field is optional — enable it and pick a file (e.g. a medical report) to attach a supporting document.
The 'attachment' field is optional — enable it and pick a file (e.g. a medical report) to attach a supporting document.
The response includes a 'teamConflicts' array showing any overlapping approved leave on the same team, surfaced to the reviewer at decision time.
Streams the supporting document (e.g. medical report) as a binary download. Accessible to the requesting employee, their manager (same department), or HR.
Accessing another employee's data (a non-self employeeId) is hr_admin-only — managers get 403, matching the story's 'HR only' requirement for emergency/medical data.
hr_admin-only for a non-self employeeId.
Edit an existing emergency contact. Self, or HR only for another employee's contact.
Self, or HR only for another employee's contact.
hr_admin-only for a non-self employeeId.

request.description: Internal note visible only to HR/managers, appended to the candidate's file.
Streams the candidate's resume as a binary download. manager/hr_admin only (same as the rest of this module).
hr_admin only. Creates a User + Employee record from the candidate and marks their stage as 'hired'. 'password' is optional in the body — a random one is generated if omitted.

Omit 'scheduledAt' to let Smart Scheduling auto-find the next open slot. If 'scheduledAt' is given and it conflicts with an existing interview for the same interviewer(s), the API returns 409 unless 'force: true' is set. Notifies every interviewer in-app, and records a candidate-notification timestamp (candidateNotifiedAt) — candidates have no login, so this is the integration point for an outbound email/SMS provider.
Requires explicit candidate consent: either 'consentGiven: true' in this request, or the interview already has consentGiven=true from a prior 'Run AI Scribe' call. Otherwise returns 400.
Streams the interview recording as a binary download. manager/hr_admin only (same as the rest of this module).

request.description: hr_admin only. Marks every active employee with no attendance record on the given date (default: today) as 'absent' (or 'leave' if covered by an approved leave request). Runs automatically every night via cron; this lets you trigger it on demand for testing/backfill. Skips weekends (Fri/Sat).
A plain employee only sees payroll records with status 'approved' (i.e. issued payslips) — draft records awaiting HR approval are hidden. manager/hr_admin see both.

Manual payroll entry — you supply baseSalary directly. For an attendance-based calculation, use 'Generate Payroll (Auto, from Attendance)' instead. Saved with status 'draft' — call 'Approve Payroll' to issue the payslip to the employee.

Uses the employee's baseSalary and their attendance record for the month (working week: Sun-Thu) to compute a per-day deduction for each unpaid absence, then applies optional bonuses/deductions on top. Saved with status 'draft' — call 'Approve Payroll' to issue the payslip to the employee. Run 'Mark Absentees (HR Sweep)' first so absence deductions aren't 0.
hr_admin only. Marks a draft payroll record as 'approved', issuing the payslip: it becomes visible to the employee and downloadable as a PDF, and the employee is notified.
Accessible to the owning employee, their manager, or HR — but only once the payroll record has status 'approved' (returns 400 for drafts).

'inApp' controls whether in-app notifications are created for this user. 'email' (default false) controls whether the same update is also emailed via Gmail SMTP — requires GMAIL_USER/GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD to be set server-side, otherwise sending no-ops.
hr_admin only. Returns today's attendance counts, pending leave requests, documents expiring within 30 days, this month's payroll total, and a 7-day attendance trend.
Monthly present/absent/late day counts and hours worked per employee, optionally filtered by department.
Downloads the same report as a binary file. Set format=pdf for a PDF instead of an .xlsx.
Exits / average headcount for the period, expressed as a percentage.

query.description: optional — defaults to each employee's most recent score
